description: A ground-level photograph depicts a large, well-maintained golf course located in Täby, Sweden. The foreground and midground feature expansive green fairways with several small, dark figures visible, indicating golfers on the course. White, winding paths traverse the green areas. Towards the background, multiple water features, including ponds with active fountains, are visible. The landscape is dotted with numerous trees, and in the far background, buildings, possibly a clubhouse or residential structures, are nestled amidst additional tree cover. This image represents a type of "green urban area" which, in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) classifications, falls under categories like "sports fields" or "leisure parks" (e.g., within a "1.4 areas" classification).
